value.title: Opt-in watchdog start interval: pij watchdog on <seat> --start 2m --every 20m
value.summary: Add a start interval to the opt-in seat watchdog: `pij watchdog on <seat> --start 2m --every 20m`. The first stall check uses --start; after the seat's first report or the first start nudge, the watchdog uses --every with no second call.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Vaughan via the Tether prime (pij-causal-salamander), brief tether-governance/.harness/government/briefs/xgov-pij-watchdog-start.md. A stream seat that acks its brief and then idles is caught only by --every, so primes arm `--every 2m` at spawn and rely on the seat re-arming itself `--every 20m` after its first report; the seat forgetting is the failure. `--start <dur>` makes the first check short and switches to `--every` by itself.

sections.name: goals
value: `pij watchdog on [<seat>] --start <dur> [--every <dur>]` arms a short first stall check that hands over to --every with no second call.
`pij watchdog status` shows both intervals and which phase is active.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Changing when a seat counts as stalled (working or parked seats stay silent; the plan-178 answered-nudge brake stays).
Deploying the daemon (a separate, owner-coordinated bounce).

value.claim: Grammar: `watchdog on [<seat>] [--start <dur>] [--every <dur>]`. --start is at least 1m (same floor as --every), only with `on`, and refused when repeated; the usage text names it. --start alone keeps the default --every.

Store: migration 0031 adds `start_secs` (NULL or > 0) and `started_at` to `seat_watchdogs`. Rows from before it read as no start (every phase). set/list round-trip both; ending the start phase is a conditional update keyed on the row's `set_at`, so a re-arm is never marked by a stale round.

Round: in the start phase a seat quiet for --start is nudged once; `started_at` is persisted BEFORE the nudge is sent; afterwards the quiet interval is --every, measured from that nudge. A `report.now` by the seat after arming ends the start phase with no nudge. Working or parked seats stay silent in both phases; --every alone is unchanged.

Status and receipts: each opt-in in `status` carries `start_secs`, `started_at_ms`, `phase` (start|every) and `active_interval_secs`; the phase is derived live from the seat's latest report.now, so it is right before the round persists it. The `on` receipt and the subject's FYI name the start interval; the start nudge says it is the start check and names the --every that follows.

Re-arm: `on` with the same --start and --every is a no-op (phase kept, audited `watchdog.unchanged`); any change rewrites the row with `set_at` now and the start phase restarted when --start is given. To restart an identical start window: `off` then `on`.
value.note: on_with_start... (identical re-arm no-op; --every alone drops --start); MW8

sections.name: risks_assumptions
sections.value: last_event_at counts every spine event for the seat, including watchdog.on and watchdog.nudge, so it cannot mark the first report; the edge reads the latest `report.now` (CARD_EVENT_KIND) via spine.latest_matching, as the PA path does. A daemon restart loses the in-memory nudged map; started_at is persisted, so the start phase never repeats.
